summary_1line: A Brahmana explains cosmology: elements arise from egoism, senses and organs link to elements and deities, beings’ births vary, and mastery of senses leads to realization of Brahman.

image_candidates.scene_text: At the cosmic dissolution, the elements collapse one into another as terrified beings watch the universe dissolve into primordial essence.
A sage sits in deep meditation while the five elements and their corresponding senses radiate around him in symbolic forms.
A cosmic diagram shows ear, skin, eyes, tongue, and nose linked to ether, wind, light, water, and earth with their presiding deities surrounding them.
